literals.boolean: true / false (unquoted symbols; some dialects use 0 / -1)

memory_model.notes: Transpiles to Python; relies on Python's reference-counting + cycle GC. Documented as host_gc since the user program cannot observe GC behavior directly.

functions.name: print
functions.description: Print to stdout with newline.

functions.name: input
functions.description: Read one line from stdin (no trailing newline).

functions.name: list
functions.description: Build a list from arguments. `list(1, 2, 3)`.

functions.name: len
functions.description: Length of a string, list, or dict.

functions.name: get
functions.description: Read element by index (list) or key (dict). Returns null if absent.

functions.name: set
functions.description: Mutate element by index or key. Returns the collection.

functions.name: push
functions.description: Append to the end of a list. Returns the list.

functions.name: pop
functions.description: Remove and return the last element of a list.

functions.name: dict
functions.description: Build a dict from alternating key, value arguments.

functions.name: has
functions.description: True if a dict has the key, or list has the index.

functions.name: keys
functions.description: List of keys in a dict (insertion order).

functions.name: range
functions.description: List of integers. `range(n)` is 0..n-1; `range(a, b)` is a..b-1.

functions.name: str
functions.description: Convert any value to its printable string.

functions.name: split
functions.description: Split a string on a separator, return list of pieces.

functions.name: join
functions.description: Join a list of strings with a separator.

functions.name: upper
functions.description: Uppercase a string.

functions.name: lower
functions.description: Lowercase a string.

functions.name: replace
functions.description: Replace every occurrence of `old` with `new` in `s`.

functions.name: int
functions.description: Convert string or float to int.

functions.name: float
functions.description: Convert string or int to float.

functions.name: read_file
functions.description: Read a UTF-8 text file as a string.

functions.name: write_file
functions.description: Write a string to a file (overwrites). Returns null.

functions.name: argv
functions.description: List of command-line arguments after the program name.

functions.name: exit
functions.description: Exit the program with an integer status code.

origin_story: forthlang is the hand-written reference stack_based dialect that ships with Forge. New Forth-flavored languages template from it instead of being LLM-generated, dropping creation time from minutes to seconds.
